So the mapping lives in the renderer only; the dataset door's refusal of an undeclared or dotted key is unchanged (maintainer ruling 6902027136 「REST 也拒绝(收紧)」). 165 ADR hits on the title terms, none on this; surface grep on DatasetWidget.tsx: 9 hit lines, none on the compare window.
